title: An element of the function field regular at every point of an open set is a section over it
statement: Let $X$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] with generic point $\eta$ and function field $k(X)=\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$ [def-sc-function-field]. For $x\in X$ write $\rho_x:\mathcal O_{X,x}\to k(X)$ for the map of stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] sending the germ at $x$ of a section $s\in\mathcal O_X(W)$ ($W$ an open neighbourhood of $x$, which contains $\eta$) to the germ of $s$ at $\eta$, and for a nonempty open $U\subseteq X$ write $\rho_U:\mathcal O_X(U)\to k(X)$, $s\mapsto s_\eta$. Let $U\subseteq X$ be a nonempty open subset and $g\in k(X)$ an element such that $g\in\rho_x(\mathcal O_{X,x})$ for every $x\in U$. Then there is a section $s\in\mathcal O_X(U)$ with $\rho_U(s)=g$.
